s/adc/0/sel.brief: Select the ADC channel for ADC0 streaming.

s/adc/1/sel.brief: Select the ADC channel for ADC1 streaming.

s/adc/mode.detail:
Mode 1 decimates every ADC channel by 2 and interleaves
ch0/ch1 onto adc/0 and ch2/ch3 onto adc/1 (ignoring adc/N/sel).
The host deinterleaves with data[0::2] / data[1::2].

s/adc/epoch.brief: ADC frame epoch tag (PCTS use only).
s/adc/epoch.detail:
Toggle after advancing the calibration point.  The bit rides in
the ADC frame header (commit source bit 3 -> host index bit 3),
so stale in-flight frames from the previous point carry the old
value and can be discarded by the host.

s/i/range/src.brief: The source for the current range streaming channel.

s/i/range/select.brief: The current range manual shunt resistor selection.

s/i/range/min.brief: The least sensitive current range for autoranging

s/i/range/max.brief: The most sensitive current range for autoranging

s/i/range/predict.detail:
On overflow, the autoranger first hops to this range (when it is
below the active range and ADC1 is parked and settled there)
before falling through to i/range/min if the current still
overflows.  0 disables prediction: overflow snaps straight to
i/range/min.

s/i/i0_sel.brief: The manual shunt resistor selection for ADC0.

s/i/i1_sel.brief: The manual shunt resistor selection for ADC1.

s/i/i2_sel.brief: The manual shunt resistor selection for ADC2.

s/i/order.brief: The priority order for which ADC input to use.

s/stats/scnt.brief: Number of 1 Msps samples per block.

s/stats/ctrl.brief: Enable stats input data stream messages.

s/gpi/0/ctrl.brief: Enable general purpose input 0 data stream

s/gpi/1/ctrl.brief: Enable general purpose input 1 data stream

s/gpi/2/ctrl.brief: Enable general purpose input 2 data stream

s/gpi/3/ctrl.brief: Enable general purpose input 3 data stream

s/gpi/+/dwnN/mode.brief: The general purpose inputs and trigger downsampling mode

s/gpi/+/dwnN/N.brief: The general purpose inputs and trigger downsample factor 0 - 16383

s/gpi/+/dwnN/!ack.brief: Acknowledge gpi/+/dwnN/{mode,N} applied.  Value is the 16 MHz sample_id at which the new GPI decimation takes effect.

s/gpi/src.brief: Source for the GPI streaming bus (diagnostic).
s/gpi/src.detail: Selects what feeds the gpi_decimate path. Mode 0 is the normal hardware GPI bus; modes 1 and 2 route internal ovr bits for autorange diagnostics.

s/gpo/0/src.brief: Source byte for gpo[0] (8-bit {N[3:0], rsv, src[2:0]}).
s/gpo/0/src.detail:
[2:0] = source code
0  register   (drives the *_reg input from regfile)
1  pps        (future, drives 0)
2  uart       (future, drives 0)
3  analog PCM (dsm_out from the shared analog_out instance)
4  trigger N  (future, drives 0)
5  overflow N (ovr[N])
6  select N   (select[N])
7  reserved   (drives 0)
[7:4] N: 4-bit channel index for sources 4-6.

s/gpo/1/src.brief: Source byte for gpo[1] (8-bit {N[3:0], rsv, src[2:0]}).

s/gpo/7/src.brief: Source byte for trigger_out (8-bit {N[3:0], rsv, src[2:0]}).

s/gpo/+/!value.brief: Force the GPO register bits (8-bit, used when the corresponding gpo/N/src is 0).

s/gpo/+/!set.brief: Set the indicated GPO register bits (only bits [7] trigger_out and [1:0] gpo).

s/gpo/+/!clr.brief: Clear the indicated GPO register bits (only bits [7] trigger_out and [1:0] gpo).

s/gpo/+/!req.brief: GPO read-back request; 0=gpo_val register, 1=post-mux output (gpo_status). Result on gpo/+/!raw.

s/aout/value.brief: Manual 16-bit signed value driven to the PCM when src=4.

s/aout/shift.brief: Left-shift count applied to the 48-bit latch (0..32).

s/aout/!req.brief: Read back the actual analog_out FPGA register; result on aout/!raw.

s/aout/!raw.brief: Most recent analog_out FPGA register raw u32 reading.

s/dwnN/N.brief: The downsampling factor 0 - 1027 for i, v, p from 1 Msps
s/dwnN/N.detail: Downsampling factors 0, 1 are passthrough.  2, 3 promote to 4.  Values 4-1000 perform downsampling.

s/dwnN/mode.brief: The downsampling filter for i, v, p
s/dwnN/mode.detail: The sincN CIC order.  bypass passes through regardless of N.  The first order-1 outputs after a change are settling transients (0 for sinc1, 1 for sinc2, 2 for sinc3).

s/dwnN/!ack.brief: Acknowledge dwnN/{N,mode} applied.  Value is the 16 MHz sample_id at which the new decimation takes effect.

s/fuse/0/engaged.brief: Set to 1 when engaged, publish 0 to clear.

s/fuse/1/engaged.brief: Set to 1 when engaged, publish 0 to clear.

s/fuse/30/en.brief: Enable/disable the global per-channel fuse.  DISABLE AT YOUR OWN RISK.

s/fuse/30/engaged.brief: Set to 1 when engaged, publish 0 to clear.

s/fuse/31/en.brief: Enable/disable the global max fuse.  DISABLE AT YOUR OWN RISK.

s/fuse/31/engaged.brief: Set to 1 when engaged, publish 0 to clear.
